description: Read public references or records your account may access. Use it for participants, owned documents, saved receipts and private history; use trade for live sales and runs, or read_thread for chat. Most reads are free; ref.kind=profile is a paid inspection that records a receipt under the disclosed fee. Supply the exact ref and preserve its cursor, filters and request_id where required. Retry a paid inspection with identical instructions and the same ID. It returns the selected record, billing and any next-page cursor.

sort.description: Ordering for this exact query; keep it with its cursor. newest: most recently created first; oldest_listed: longest-listed first.

status.description: Lifecycle subset or declared availability for this record. draft: private unpublished content; pending_submission: awaiting catalogue admission; listed: currently published stock; reserved: a recorded buyer holds the item; sold: sale recorded as completed; unsold: closed without a completed sale; withdrawn: withdrawn from public trading.

tab.description: Participant profile section to read. all: include every permitted category; players: recorded buyer activity; traders: recorded seller activity; sold: sale recorded as completed; feedback: existing public reputation comments; about: public bio and website.

uri.description: Exact canonical resource URI returned by SIBIDZ.

version.description: Exact published document or pricing version; copy it from the preceding read.

ref.description: Exact public or private record reference; ownership is checked on every read.

name: browse

0.description: Effective link-only visibility, including a secret parent event. Independent of lifecycle and frozen terms.

1.description: Owner only: this listing or event’s own setting.

2.description: Owner only: a secret parent event prevents making this listing public.

3.description: Owner only: optimistic revision required for visibility changes and link rotation.

4.description: Owner only, when effectively secret: absolute unguessable share URL. Never returned to a non-owner or inside another object’s catalogue.

billing.description: charged, assessed, balance and available_credits are whole SBZ strings or null; receipt_id identifies the saved fee. Replays never charge twice.

committed_stages.description: Stages already committed before a later refusal; retain their receipts.

data.description: Requested public/owned record, durable receipt and opaque pagination cursor. IDs are exact returned identifiers (UUID where declared); prices retain amount/currency (123 USD); times use ISO 8601 UTC; cursors are opaque.

error.description: Optional business error: code, message, HTTP status, retryable and recovery details.

next.description: Exactly one required continuation: call, input, approval, choice, wait or done. It never grants new consent.

pagination.description: Optional next-page call; not required work or consent.

retry.description: Optional exact request_id and permitted recovery call.

state.description: Outcome: finished, still processing, needs approval/input, or refused.

summary.description: Plain-language result, including a business error.
